title: add browser-runtime-qa workflow role for Chrome DevTools MCP runtime validation
problem_statement: Extend the PI.Onion agent workflow with a dedicated browser runtime QA role for Chrome DevTools MCP evidence, separate from build, impact analysis, diff review, and game design.
game_flow_context: workflow-only governance change; no runtime gameplay code, CSS, JS, config, asset, or data change
validated_decisions: Do not modify build-agent, review-maintainability-guard, or impact-regression-guard.
browser-runtime-qa works when current_owner is browser-runtime-qa and status is BUILD_DONE.
browser-runtime-qa does not modify code, CSS, JS, config, assets, or runtime data.
browser-runtime-qa uses Chrome DevTools MCP only to collect observable browser runtime evidence.
Passing runtime QA proposes IN_REVIEW and returns to task-orchestrator.
Failing runtime QA proposes NEEDS_REWORK or BLOCKED and returns to task-orchestrator.
No RUNTIME_QA_DONE canonical state is introduced.
AGENTS.md references pixel-artist, but .agents/skills/pixel-artist/SKILL.md does not exist; this mismatch is declared and left for a separate task.
Markdown files created/modified are non-empty and relevant references resolve by text search.
Git status shows no runtime game file modified by this task.
LOG-003 proposes DONE and returns to task-orchestrator.
No required rework remains for PI-011 before closure.
draft_assumptions_in_play: Chrome DevTools MCP server is globally configured by the user as chrome-devtools.
The current task should not run browser runtime QA; it only adds the workflow role.
A separate task should decide whether to create or remove pixel-artist.
current_direction: Keep runtime browser QA as a dedicated no-code role.
Route browser-runtime-qa after build-agent and before review-maintainability-guard.

explicit_non_goals: No CSS, JS, config, asset, sound, or data changes.
No changes to build-agent, review-maintainability-guard, or impact-regression-guard.
No creation of pixel-artist in this task.
No Chrome DevTools runtime QA run in this task.
freeze_zones: Runtime code and data are frozen for this task.
Existing thread 010 untracked files are not part of this task.

backward_compatibility_concerns: Introducing a browser QA role must not imply it can edit code or replace maintainability review.
Adding a workflow step after build-agent may affect future routing expectations.
